scope: Pinned reconstruction attachment and arbitrary-quad reading; not native Leona CPU execution

observations.observation: Standing uses RyRxRz. Missile matrix columns are right, horizontal travel, down; source XY is horizontal.
Arbitrary quads use the composed particle basis with no ground-specific rotation bypass.
Source XY expands through basis columns; ground mode then sets world Y.
World acceleration adds unturned displacement after source placement. Particle-local orientation selects current frame instead of stored birth frame.
Birth Euler rotation is sampled without rotationEnabled gating.
Birth frame carries system orientation; rotationEnabled gates extra integrated rotation0, not birth rotation.

localBindings: Weapon phase takes the documented missile frame; dash/contact preserve the current upright unit-root policy. Actual native Leona script/object matrices remain unknown.
Existing local vertical terrain projection and 2cm lift retained; native ground shader/terrain technique not certified.
World-axis displacement/velocity separated from the prepared raw particle result at the binding boundary.
Source X reflection, missing globals, blend/depth state and bound-object size remain local presentation choices.
